descriptor_comparison.method: Reused fresh frozen original evaluation by independently proven identical pixel bytes; no repeated metric execution.

G1_G2.method: Endpoints and gap<=spacing on changed line-set pieces; exact nearest segments; distance is1-Lipschitz, add gap/2. Floating GEOS, no interval claim.

features.interpretation: Finite axis chords and raster medial support; a shorter axial chord is a geometric flag, not a mechanical neck strength estimate.
